quotes.text: What a magical night in Venice! That is how we felt as we glided at dusk down the Providence River with Gondolier Marcello and accordion player Maria. A beautiful night - calm and still with a crescent moon. The four of us sipping wine as Maria softly played in the moonlight. We had a “moment” when in the hushed silence of our ride Marcello sang “Ave Maria”. BEAUTIFUL! We truly enjoyed our experience and I have been telling everyone about it. Thank you to Marcello for ending the night by singing Happy Birthday in Italian to us!

We came at the end of the season and unfortunately at what turned out to be a blustery evening (not forcast)Our gondelier, Marcello, was a very skilled oarsman and gave us a wonderful ride and beautiful views of the city and a sample of his glorious voice. Royalty could not have been treated better. The story that this particular gondola had participated in the New Orleans rescues made the trip even more special. Oh, enjoy the Bellinis, we did. Non alcoholic, but you can fix them up if you have the urge.

My husband of 52 years and I spent a peaceful, quiet,and interesting early evening ride on a stunning gondola through the center of Providence. We were entertained by a talented mandolin player(Don) and an accomplished singer/rower and travel guide, Rosario. Both young men were fun to travel with while the city passed by. When the ride was finished,we both were relaxed and ready for dinner on Federal Hill. What a nice way to start an evening in the city. Thanks for making everything perfect.

My husband Michael planned a gondola ride for part of my birthday celebration. Along with our friends Sue and Bill, we all had an absolutely awesome time. The weather was perfect and the water very calm as Raphaello and Don serenaded us with beautiful music.We enjoyed crackers, cheese and wine while feeling like we were the only ones around. It was wonderful to see the city from a different perspective and the views were wonderful. We truly felt special during the entire ride.

We shared our gondola ride with two close friends, Maureen and Rick, the week before their wedding. What a lovely start to a wedding week! The weather was perfect - warm and breezy. Alessandro, the gondolier, provided us with a smooth-as-silk ride, while Luciano, the baritone, serenaded us beautifully, in Italian. The entire experience was lovely. We even bought the commemorative wine glasses! We recommend La Gondola highly.

Dear La Gondola,We took our young children on a Gondola ride on Saturday, May 27th before Waterfire. Our gondola was a majestic hand carved masterpiece straight out of dream, and our guide, Rafael, could not have been nicer. What a great way to see the revitalized downtown Providence riverfront! We are sure to ride again the next time we are in town. Thank you for a wonderful experience!
